title: GoOrganicAfrica 44-country calculator readiness — Batch 26: Malawi

administrative_geography.boundary_count_note: The standard 28-district council listing is used. Newer NSO/OCHA Common Operational Dataset boundary data also includes four city-district units (Blantyre City, Lilongwe City, Mzuzu City and Zomba City), making 32 level-2 boundary units if counted separately. The calculator region selector uses the three regions only.

market_price_evidence.current_series: IFPRI Malawi Monthly Maize Market Reports and FAO FPMA provide market-level retail-price observations; extraction by market, date, grade, product form and unit remains pending.
market_price_evidence.warning: Historical policy floors and retail observations must not be used as current 2026 farmgate prices.

readiness.2025_NACA: Published by NSO; report covers 29,648 smallholder households and estimates at national, regional, ADD, district, urban and rural levels. Detailed extraction and precision review pending.
readiness.crop_data: Official APES 2024/25 national crop totals and ADD maize production extracted; regional/district crop area and yield tables pending.
readiness.costs: Current seed, fertilizer, crop protection, labour, machinery, irrigation, energy and transport cost schedules not yet validated.

blockers: Extract 2025 NACA crop area/yield and production system tables by district and ADD; assess sample precision.
Obtain 2025/26 APES final crop production, area and yield tables where published.
Extract dated market prices and obtain current farmgate prices for each calculator crop.
Obtain farmer-paid seed, fertilizer, crop protection, labour, mechanization, land preparation, irrigation, energy and transport costs.
Build and test regional enterprise budgets and MWK calculator test cases.
Confirm crop taxonomy, especially beans, cowpeas, pigeon peas and rice product form.
safeguards: Malawi remains not_active and directory_only in the calculator registry.
The three regions are added to the region lookup without changing existing country region records.
The 28-district council convention is stated explicitly; four city-district units in newer boundary data are not conflated with it.
National crop production is not converted into regional yield or farm-level output assumptions.
ADD-level maize production is not relabelled as district production or regional yield.
Historical farmgate floor prices and retail market prices are not presented as current 2026 farmgate quotations.
No activation, merge to main or production deployment was performed.
next_step: Extract detailed 2025 NACA small-area tables and current APES observations; assemble dated farmgate prices and farmer-paid costs; build region-specific enterprise budgets before activation.
